record.original_question: Suppose F is a factor, that is, an invariant sub-sigma-algebra, for the ergodic product system T tensor T, and suppose F is independent of the two coordinate sigma-algebras. Must the entropy of the automorphism T then be positive?

evidence.quote: Независимый фактор. Не решен следующий весьма частный случай этой задачи.

Q10. Пусть алгебра F (фактор) является инвариантной относительно эргодического произведения T ⊗ T и независима от координатных алгебр. Верно ли, что в этом случае энтропия автоморфизма T положительна?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu,T)$ be an invertible ergodic measure-preserving automorphism of a standard probability space. Consider the product system $(X\times X,\mathcal{B}\otimes\mathcal{B},\mu\otimes\mu,T\otimes T)$, and assume it is ergodic. Let $\mathcal{F}\subset\mathcal{B}\otimes\mathcal{B}$ be a $(T\otimes T)$-invariant sub-$\sigma$-algebra (a factor) that is independent of each of the two coordinate $\sigma$-algebras $\mathcal{B}\otimes\{\emptyset,X\}$ and $\{\emptyset,X\}\otimes\mathcal{B}$ with respect to $\mu\otimes\mu$. Must the Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy $h(T)$ be strictly positive?
artifact.status_search_result: The question (whether an invariant sub-σ-algebra of the ergodic self-product T⊗T that is independent of both coordinate σ-algebras forces h(T)>0) is stated as an unresolved special case in the ergodic-theory literature on self-joinings and self-products. Recent work on self-products and entropy does not report a resolution, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Some remarks about self-products and entropy
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses self-products of ergodic systems and entropy, related to factors of T×T independent of coordinates.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on self-products and entropy treats related questions but does not resolve this independence-implies-positive-entropy problem.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Dynamical Systems & Ergodic Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open problems in ergodic theory.
status_evidence.claim: Problems concerning factors of self-products and entropy remain listed among open questions in ergodic theory.
